shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -40 package-lock.json; node --version

cd /tmp && rm -rf smoke && mkdir smoke && cd smoke
DATA_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456 node /workspace/server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -d "title=The Hobbit&author=J.R.R. Tolkien&notes=Re-read, second time." localhost:3456/books
ID=$(node -e "console.log(require('/tmp/smoke/books.json')[0].id)")
kill $PID; sleep 0.3
DATA_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456 node /workspace/server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s localhost:3456/books/$ID | grep -E "<h2>|author|notes\"|readonly"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -d "back=book" localhost:3456/books/$ID/finish
curl -s localhost:3456/ | grep -A3 "<h2>Finished" | head -8
kill $PID; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json
